peerMapping.justification: EWY is a Korea equity ETF whose performance is dominated by semiconductor memory exposure, chiefly Samsung Electronics and SK hynix, plus a foreign-investor risk-on flow component. The primary hedge is DRAM, a memory-focused equity ETF, because shorting that basket neutralizes the exact memory-cycle factor that drives most of EWY's return more directly than any broad index or commodity. Peers are weighted by economic comparability to that memory factor, with all displayed 24-hour perp liquidity figures preserved in USD millions: target liquidity is 6.848, and every selected peer trades comfortably above that level (SMSN 7.229, SKHX 34.707, MU 21.299, SKHY 14.334, SNDK 98.839, XYZ100 52.585, CXMT 9.812), so the weighting scheme is not liquidity-constrained. Samsung and the two SK hynix lines together carry 0.58 because they are literal EWY constituents; Micron, Sandisk, and CXMT carry 0.32 as global memory-cycle substitutes and supply-side competitors; Nasdaq-100 carries 0.10 to capture the risk-on flow channel; weights sum to exactly 1.00.

peers.name: Samsung Electronics common
peers.reason: Samsung Electronics common is the single largest constituent of EWY, roughly a quarter of the fund, so it is the dominant source of the ETF's return and shares the same DRAM, NAND, and foundry cycle; it receives the highest peer weight because it is literally the target's core holding.

peers.name: SK hynix common
peers.reason: SK hynix common is one of the dominant holdings behind EWY, so returns share DRAM, HBM, memory-cycle, and Korean export sensitivity; displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 34.707 USD millions, supporting the largest peer weight.

peers.name: Micron Technology
peers.reason: Micron is the US memory peer whose DRAM and NAND pricing, capital spending discipline, and AI high-bandwidth memory demand move with the Korean memory complex that drives EWY. Displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 21.299 USD millions, deep enough for a meaningful but not dominant weight.

peers.name: Sandisk
peers.reason: Sandisk is a NAND and flash storage substitute and competitor to the memory franchises that dominate EWY; displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is very high at 98.839 USD millions, but the product mix is narrower than Samsung, so the weight is capped.

peers.name: CXMT Corp. Class A
peers.reason: CXMT is a Chinese DRAM producer whose wafer supply decisions influence the worldwide memory price that EWY's holdings monetize, so it is a supply-side substitute relationship in the same factor.

peers.name: Roundhill Memory ETF
peers.reason: The Roundhill Memory ETF is a diversified memory basket that substitutes for the sector sleeve inside EWY rather than a generic equity factor; displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 20.791 USD millions.

peers.name: SK hynix ADR
peers.reason: The SK hynix ADR line duplicates the common-share exposure through a different access wrapper, so it is included for completeness but weighted lower to avoid double-counting the same factor.

primary_index_hedge.name: Roundhill Memory ETF
primary_index_hedge.reason: Despite the legacy field name primary_index_hedge, the best hedge here is an equity ETF rather than an index: EWY's return is driven overwhelmingly by the semiconductor memory cycle through Samsung Electronics and SK hynix, so shorting DRAM, the Roundhill Memory ETF, directly neutralizes that dominant factor more precisely than shorting a broad equity index would.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted and remaining weights renormalized once at least three peers exist; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's TradeXYZ close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

underlierSelection.method: highest summed live contract volume; open interest and contract count break ties

model.name: ATM-straddle-implied lognormal distribution
model.description: Each target uses the nearest paired liquid ATM call and put. Their combined ask implies the expiration distribution shown on the chart.
model.measure: option-implied, not a historical or physical forecast
